_comment: Connector-specific edits a cli-printing-press reprint must NOT clobber. check_handfixes.py asserts every marker below is still present and fails CI if a reprint dropped one.

handfixes.summary: DATAGATE_CLIENT_ID is read into the generic Headers map so every request carries the required ClientId header alongside the Bearer token
handfixes.why: DataGate's auth needs a Bearer token AND a separate required ClientId header (a GUID) on every request. The spec format has no first-class slot for a second required secret header, so this rides in on the generic per-request Headers map instead. This is a GENERATOR-class gap (no first-class multi-credential-header auth mode) rather than a DataGate-specific bug; until the press supports it natively, a reprint regenerates config.go without this block and these markers guard the connector.
